questions.question: After saying His hand made heaven and earth, whom does the LORD say He will esteem?

answers.text: The humble one who trembles at His word
The one who brings the grandest offerings
The one with the most famous name

questions.question: The LORD said He would bring terror on people who chose their own ways. What reason did He give?

answers.text: He called and no one answered
They moved to a far country

questions.question: In the LORD's picture of a nation born in a single day, who is the mother giving birth to her children?
The LORD said He would comfort those who love Jerusalem the way a mother comforts her son. True or false?
